forbidden.name: shared-no-reverse-deps
forbidden.comment: shared/ 是最低产品基础层，不得反向依赖 compiler/, cli/, orchestrator/, dev-runner/, upgrade/

forbidden.name: compiler-no-upward-entrypoint-deps
forbidden.comment: compiler/ 不得依赖 CLI、Orchestrator 或 DevRunner 入口层；编排只能向下调用 compiler，而不能形成反向控制边。

forbidden.name: orchestrator-no-cli-or-dev-runner
forbidden.comment: orchestrator/ 是产品编排层，不得依赖 CLI 表示层或开发期 DevRunner。

forbidden.name: product-no-codex-control-plane
forbidden.comment: 产品 platform/ 不得依赖 scripts/codex 开发控制面；Development Control Plane 只能作为外部消费者/适配器。

forbidden.name: platform-compiler-facade-boundary
forbidden.comment: 除 compiler 自身、拥有 pipeline stage 的 orchestrator 与 upgrade owner 外，platform 模块只能经 compiler facade 消费编译器能力。

forbidden.name: verification-evidence-no-child-runner
forbidden.comment: 隔离 Verification Evidence 只能消费结果合同，不能反向依赖持有执行能力的 child runner。

forbidden.name: semantic-mutation-no-upward-layer-deps
forbidden.comment: Semantic Mutation owns a compiler capability and may not depend on workspace, workbench, repair, upgrade or orchestration entry layers.

forbidden.name: semantic-foundations-no-reverse-mutation-deps
forbidden.comment: IR, semantic-impact and projection are lower compiler foundations and cannot reverse-depend on the Semantic Mutation capability.

forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: platform 产品图禁止循环依赖。

forbidden.name: no-registry-to-compiler
forbidden.comment: registry/ 是声明式资源，不得反向依赖 compiler/ 实现。
